title: Microbiology
description: Most life is too small to see, and doubles every twenty minutes while the food lasts. Unlocks Bacterial Cultures.

puzzle.goal: Bacteria double every g minutes. Starting from N cells, write how many there are, M, after t minutes.
puzzle.name: Doubling
puzzle.ask: Find M for N = @{N}, t = @{t} and g = @{g}.
puzzle.method: Each g minutes multiplies the count by two, so t minutes multiply it by 2^(t/g).
